no-third-leg-recognition-h1c1.primary_text: One lead source going quiet should not put your crew at risk. John Vandervalk of Mountainside ER+ added Google leads to the mix.
no-third-leg-recognition-h1c1.headline: Do not run on one lead source

leads-to-hires-proof-h1.primary_text: Google leads became booked jobs, and booked jobs became new hires. John says there is "no shortage of work."
leads-to-hires-proof-h1.headline: From Google leads to new hires

new-services-proof-h1.primary_text: Customers started asking Mountainside ER+ about site prep, excavation and grading. John Vandervalk says better marketing on Google is part of why.
new-services-proof-h1.headline: Customers ask for more

personal-side-objection-h1b1.primary_text: Software can build you a website. It cannot be the person on the call. John Vandervalk likes "having the Zoom calls where I can bounce ideas off."
personal-side-objection-h1b1.headline: A person to bounce ideas off

too-many-hats-recognition-h1b1.primary_text: Wearing every hat keeps you out of the role where you crush it. John Vandervalk got help with the Google side of his business.
too-many-hats-recognition-h1b1.headline: Stop wearing every hat

contractor-referral-proof-h1b1.primary_text: John Vandervalk heard it from a contractor friend: "the best hire I've made to grow a business."
contractor-referral-proof-h1b1.headline: Word of mouth from a contractor
